meta.name: PhysAlts Private Institutes & Deep-Tech Companies
meta.description: Curated global directory of 60 private physics research institutes, quantum computing firms, fusion energy ventures, photonics/EUV leaders, cryogenic hardware makers, and aerospace physics companies.

hubs.name: Quantinuum
hubs.summary: Merged Honeywell Quantum Solutions and Cambridge Quantum to build high-fidelity trapped-ion quantum computers (H-Series) with record two-qubit gate accuracy and fault-tolerant logical qubits.

stages.highschool: Explore trapped-ion quantum computing tutorials and TKET open-source circuit compilation notebooks.
stages.undergrad: Summer hardware & quantum software internships in Broomfield, Minneapolis, Oxford, and Cambridge.
stages.masters: MSc thesis collaborations & graduate engineering internships in ion-trap optics, cryogenics, and TKET.
stages.phd: PhD research internships in fault-tolerant quantum error correction, quantum chemistry, and trapped-ion physics.
stages.postdoc: Staff Research Scientist roles transitioning directly from AMO, trapped-ion, or quantum-info postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint academic-industry benchmarking grants and early H-Series hardware access for university groups.
stages.prof: Scientific advisory roles, multi-institution quantum error-correction consortia, and visiting research collaborations.

hubs.name: PsiQuantum
hubs.summary: Developing utility-scale fault-tolerant photonic quantum computers fabricated on commercial silicon-photonics semiconductor lines with superconducting single-photon detectors.

stages.highschool: Learn silicon photonics and single-photon interference fundamentals through open quantum optics resources.
stages.undergrad: Paid summer engineering & physics internships in Palo Alto (photonics design, cryo-testing, software).
stages.masters: MSc/MEng internships and full-time roles in silicon-photonics PIC layout, cryogenic packaging, and FPGA control.
stages.phd: PhD internships & R&D scientist tracks in integrated photonics, SNSPD detectors, and fusion-based QEC architectures.
stages.postdoc: Quantum Architect and Principal Photonics Scientist roles for postdocs in quantum optics or condensed matter.
stages.assoc_prof: Collaborative foundry & cryogenic testbed partnerships with academic photonics and QEC theory groups.
stages.prof: Large-scale utility-application partnerships (materials/chemistry) and joint government-funded quantum consortia.

hubs.name: IonQ
hubs.summary: Spun out of University of Maryland and Duke University, building all-to-all connected ytterbium and barium trapped-ion quantum processors and photonic quantum networking.

stages.highschool: Run introductory quantum circuits on IonQ cloud simulators and study atomic-physics laser cooling basics.
stages.undergrad: Summer internships in College Park, Seattle, and Bothell spanning optics, FPGA electronics, and quantum algorithms.
stages.masters: Graduate internships and engineering roles in vacuum systems, RF trap design, and cloud quantum compilers.
stages.phd: PhD research internships & Scientist roles in barium/ytterbium ion traps, photonic interconnects, and quantum networking.
stages.postdoc: Senior Quantum Physicist roles for AMO and trapped-ion postdocs scaling networked multi-core QPU modules.
stages.assoc_prof: IonQ Research Credits & academic hardware-access grants via UMD, Duke, UW, and partner universities.
stages.prof: Co-PI research partnerships in quantum networking, national quantum testbeds, and scientific advisory leadership.

hubs.name: Rigetti Computing
hubs.summary: Full-stack superconducting quantum computing company operating its own dedicated Fab-1 quantum chip foundry in Fremont and modular multi-chip Ankaa processors.

stages.highschool: Program superconducting circuits with open-source pyQuil / Quilc tutorials and superconducting qubit primers.
stages.undergrad: Summer internships in Berkeley and Fremont covering cryogenic microwave engineering, chip fab, and QPU software.
stages.masters: Graduate roles in Fab-1 nanofabrication, superconducting circuit simulation, and cryogenic readout firmware.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Physicist roles in Josephson junction coherence, multi-chip couplers, and tunable-gate physics.
stages.postdoc: Staff Experimental / Theoretical Quantum Physicist positions for cQED and superconducting-device postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: NQI / DOE Superconducting Quantum Materials & Systems (SQMS) joint academic-industry research programs.
stages.prof: Multi-institution foundry fabrication partnerships (Fab-1) and national quantum testbed collaborations.

hubs.name: QuEra Computing
hubs.summary: Harvard and MIT spinout building reconfigurable neutral-atom rubidium optical-tweezer quantum computers (Aquila) and pioneering transversal fault-tolerant logical-qubit demonstrations.

stages.highschool: Experiment with analog Hamiltonian neutral-atom simulations on QuEra's open-source Bloqade SDK.
stages.undergrad: Boston-area summer internships in optical tweezers, laser stabilization, and neutral-atom algorithm design.
stages.masters: MSc/MEng internships and engineering roles in ultra-high vacuum, AOM/AOD laser control, and Rydberg compilation.
stages.phd: PhD internships & R&D Scientist tracks in Rydberg-atom logical qubits, transversal gates, and quantum simulation.
stages.postdoc: Quantum Hardware & Theory Scientist roles for ultracold-atom, AMO, and quantum-many-body postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint Harvard/MIT/academic access programs on Aquila neutral-atom QPUs and DARPA/NSF research grants.
stages.prof: Consortium leadership in fault-tolerant neutral-atom computing and joint PhD/postdoc fellowship co-supervision.

hubs.name: Pasqal
hubs.summary: Co-founded by Nobel laureate Alain Aspect from Institut d'Optique, deploying hundreds-of-qubits neutral-atom optical-tweezer quantum processors integrated with European HPC centers.

stages.highschool: Explore neutral-atom quantum computing tutorials using Pasqal's open-source Pulser library.
stages.undergrad: European summer internships (Paris-Saclay / Amsterdam) in photonics, optical instrumentation, and Python SDKs.
stages.masters: Paid 6-month M2 / Master's internships (stages) in Paris-Saclay covering optical tweezers, lasers, and QML.
stages.phd: CIFRE industrial PhD fellowships (France) and doctoral research internships in Rydberg physics and HPC-quantum.
stages.postdoc: Research Scientist positions for AMO, quantum optics, and quantum simulation postdocs across EU labs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint European HPC-QS / EuroHPC hybrid quantum-supercomputer access and Institut d'Optique collaborations.
stages.prof: European Quantum Flagship consortia, joint doctoral schools, and strategic scientific advisory partnerships.

hubs.name: Alice & Bob
hubs.summary: French quantum hardware startup engineering self-correcting superconducting 'cat qubits' that exponentially suppress bit-flip errors to slash fault-tolerant hardware overhead.

stages.highschool: Explore cat-qubit error-correction explainers and try open-source Dynamiqs / Felis quantum circuit simulators.
stages.undergrad: Paris summer internships in cryogenic microwave hardware, circuit QED simulation, and Python quantum tooling.
stages.masters: 6-month French M2 / European MSc thesis internships in superconducting resonator design and biased-noise QEC.
stages.phd: CIFRE industrial PhD tracks co-supervised with ENS Paris, Mines Paris, and Inria on bosonic cat qubits.
stages.postdoc: Quantum Hardware & Error-Correction Physicist roles for superconducting-qubit and bosonic-code postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint CNRS / Inria / academic research grants on dissipative stabilization and LDPC cat-qubit codes.
stages.prof: Co-supervision of CIFRE PhD fellows and European Quantum Flagship collaborative consortia.

hubs.name: Xanadu Quantum Technologies
hubs.summary: Photonic quantum computing pioneer developing room-temperature squeezed-light silicon-nitride chips (Borealis / Aurora) and maintaining the open-source PennyLane quantum ML library.

stages.highschool: Complete Xanadu's free interactive PennyLane Codebook and Quantum Machine Learning challenges.
stages.undergrad: Paid Toronto Residency & summer internships in quantum software (PennyLane), photonics, and quantum chemistry.
stages.masters: Graduate internships & engineering roles in silicon-nitride nanophotonics, squeezed light, and quantum compilation.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Research Scientist tracks in photonic fault-tolerant GKP qubits and quantum chemistry algorithms.
stages.postdoc: Senior Quantum Scientist roles for quantum optics, integrated photonics, and quantum-algorithm postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Open-source PennyLane academic community grants, joint Canadian NSERC Alliance projects, and workshops.
stages.prof: Major academic-industry partnerships in fault-tolerant photonic architecture and quantum chemistry benchmarks.

hubs.name: D-Wave Quantum
hubs.summary: Pioneer of commercial superconducting flux-qubit quantum annealing systems (Advantage) with 5,000+ qubits for combinatorial optimization and spin-glass dynamics simulations.

stages.highschool: Solve optimization puzzles using D-Wave's free Leap cloud quantum-annealing developer tier and Ocean SDK.
stages.undergrad: Co-op placements and summer internships in Burnaby & Palo Alto in cryogenics, flux qubits, and Python SDKs.
stages.masters: Graduate co-op & engineering roles in superconducting chip fab, cryo-packaging, and hybrid quantum-classical solvers.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Scientist positions in spin-glass dynamics, non-equilibrium quantum annealing, and qubit coherence.
stages.postdoc: Quantum Research Scientist roles for condensed-matter, statistical-physics, and superconducting-device postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Academic Leap research access for spin-glass, quantum phase transition, and optimization benchmark publications.
stages.prof: Co-authored quantum-supremacy / spin-dynamics collaborations and Canadian Mitacs/NSERC industry-academic grants.

hubs.name: Photonic Inc.
hubs.summary: Simon Fraser University spinout building optically linked silicon T-center spin qubits communicating directly at telecom wavelengths for distributed fault-tolerant quantum computing.

stages.highschool: Study silicon photonics and spin-photon entanglement fundamentals via Canadian quantum outreach resources.
stages.undergrad: Co-op placements in Coquitlam / Greater Vancouver spanning silicon optics, cryo-testing, and control electronics.
stages.masters: MSc/MASc research co-ops and engineering roles in T-center silicon spin devices and telecom-band photonics.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Mitacs Accelerate fellowships in silicon spin-photon interfaces and distributed qLDPC QEC.
stages.postdoc: Quantum Hardware & Architecture Scientist roles for solid-state spin, color-center, and quantum-networking postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint SFU / UBC / UK academic partnerships on distributed entanglement and telecom-band quantum memories.
stages.prof: Strategic R&D consortia and co-supervised graduate fellowships in scalable distributed quantum computing.

hubs.name: Riverlane
hubs.summary: Quantum error correction specialist building Deltaflow—ultra-low-latency FPGA/ASIC real-time syndrome decoders capable of decoding millions of quantum operations per second.

stages.highschool: Explore interactive Quantum Error Correction explainers and surface-code decoder visualizations.
stages.undergrad: Cambridge (UK) & Boston summer internships in FPGA/ASIC engineering, QEC simulation, and quantum software.
stages.masters: MSc / MPhil project placements and graduate roles in real-time syndrome decoding and embedded control stacks.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Research Scientist roles in qLDPC codes, fault-tolerant compilation, and decoder microarchitecture.
stages.postdoc: Quantum Information Scientist roles for QEC, fault-tolerant architecture, and quantum-control postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint UK National Quantum Computing Centre (NQCC) & academic collaborations benchmarking Deltaflow decoders.
stages.prof: Co-PI leadership on UKRI / DARPA fault-tolerant quantum computing programs and joint doctoral training.

hubs.name: Q-CTRL
hubs.summary: University of Sydney spinout applying quantum control engineering to suppress decoherence in quantum processors and build GPS-free cold-atom quantum navigation sensors.

stages.highschool: Explore Black Opal interactive visual lessons on qubits, Bloch spheres, and quantum control physics.
stages.undergrad: Summer internships in Sydney, Los Angeles, and Berlin in quantum control software, cold atoms, and DSP.
stages.masters: Graduate engineering & physics internships in optimal control, error suppression, and quantum sensing hardware.
stages.phd: PhD research internships & Quantum Control Scientist tracks in pulse engineering and cold-atom gravimetry/navigation.
stages.postdoc: Lead Quantum Physicist roles for AMO, quantum-sensing, and open-quantum-systems postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Academic Boulder Opal licenses, joint University of Sydney / ARC quantum-control grants, and co-publications.
stages.prof: Strategic defense/civilian quantum-navigation consortia and co-supervised industrial PhD programs.

hubs.name: Oxford Quantum Circuits (OQC)
hubs.summary: University of Oxford spinout building 3D coaxial 'Coaxmon' superconducting quantum computers deployed directly inside commercial colocation data centers.

stages.highschool: Learn superconducting circuit basics and 3D cavity QED principles via UK National Quantum outreach events.
stages.undergrad: UK summer placements in Reading and Oxford across cryogenic engineering, RF electronics, and quantum cloud stacks.
stages.masters: MSc/MPhys project placements & graduate roles in Coaxmon fabrication, microwave measurement, and cryo-integration.
stages.phd: Industrial PhD studentships (UK EPSRC iCASE) & R&D internships in 3D superconducting qubit scaling and calibration.
stages.postdoc: Quantum Hardware Scientist roles for superconducting-qubit, cryogenic-RF, and quantum-control postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint Oxford / UKRI collaborative R&D grants and academic cloud access on data-center-deployed QPUs.
stages.prof: Co-supervision of EPSRC CDT/iCASE doctoral researchers and UK National Quantum Technologies Programme partnerships.

hubs.name: Atom Computing
hubs.summary: First quantum hardware company to exceed 1,000 nuclear-spin neutral-atom qubits in a single array, demonstrating multi-second coherence and mid-circuit measurement.

stages.highschool: Learn how optical tweezers trap single neutral atoms using Boulder/JILA public AMO physics resources.
stages.undergrad: Paid summer internships in Boulder and Berkeley in laser optics, FPGA control, and atomic-physics instrumentation.
stages.masters: Graduate internships & optical/vacuum engineering roles supporting 1,000+ nuclear-spin qubit arrays.
stages.phd: PhD research internships & Experimental Physicist roles in alkaline-earth optical tweezers and mid-circuit readout.
stages.postdoc: Staff Atomic Physicist roles for ultracold-atom, optical-clock, and Rydberg-qubit postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint CU Boulder / UC Berkeley / academic benchmarking collaborations on logical neutral-atom qubits.
stages.prof: Multi-institution fault-tolerant quantum testbed consortia and joint federal (NSF/DOE/DARPA) research programs.

hubs.name: Infleqtion
hubs.summary: Formerly ColdQuanta, spun out of JILA/CU Boulder to commercialize neutral-atom quantum computers (Sqale), optical atomic clocks (Tiqker), and quantum RF receivers.

stages.highschool: Explore cold-atom glass-cell physics and quantum clock demonstrations through Colorado quantum outreach.
stages.undergrad: Paid summer internships in Boulder, Madison, and Oxford in laser optics, vacuum cells, and quantum software.
stages.masters: MSc/MEng engineering roles in miniaturized cold-atom physics packages, optical clocks (Tiqker), and RF sensing.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Physicist tracks in neutral-atom computing (Sqale), Rydberg RF electrometry, and atom interferometry.
stages.postdoc: Principal Quantum Physicist roles for AMO, atomic-clock, and BEC/atom-interferometry postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint JILA / UW–Madison / UK academic grants deploying cold-atom glass cells and quantum sensors.
stages.prof: Co-PI leadership on DARPA / NASA / UKRI quantum-clock and spaceborne cold-atom instrumentation missions.

hubs.name: Universal Quantum
hubs.summary: University of Sussex spinout engineering modular silicon-microchip trapped-ion quantum modules using microwave gates and fast electric-field ion shuttling links.

stages.highschool: Explore modular trapped-ion computing videos and microwave quantum-gate fundamentals via Sussex outreach.
stages.undergrad: UK summer placements near Brighton/Haywards Heath in RF/microwave electronics, microfabrication, and cryo-systems.
stages.masters: MPhys/MSc internships & graduate engineering roles in silicon ion-trap microchips and fast ion-shuttling control.
stages.phd: EPSRC iCASE PhD fellowships & internships in scalable microwave-driven trapped-ion modules and error correction.
stages.postdoc: Senior Quantum Physicist roles for trapped-ion, microfabricated-trap, and RF-control postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint University of Sussex / German DLR collaborative projects scaling modular trapped-ion architectures.
stages.prof: Co-supervision of industrial PhDs and European/UK large-scale fault-tolerant quantum hardware consortia.

hubs.name: Classiq Technologies
hubs.summary: Develops high-level quantum circuit synthesis and compilation platforms translating functional algorithms into depth- and qubit-optimized circuits across hardware backends.

stages.highschool: Join Classiq's global quantum coding competitions and free high-level quantum circuit synthesis tutorials.
stages.undergrad: Internships in Tel Aviv and remote/US teams in quantum algorithm compilation, Python SDKs, and optimization.
stages.masters: MSc thesis collaborations & Quantum Applications Engineer tracks translating physics models into optimized circuits.
stages.phd: PhD research internships in automated circuit synthesis, Hamiltonian simulation, and resource-efficient QEC compilation.
stages.postdoc: Research Scientist roles for quantum-algorithms, quantum-chemistry, and compiler-theory postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Free Classiq Academic licenses for university quantum-computing courses and joint algorithm-synthesis publications.
stages.prof: Co-authored quantum-application benchmarks and university curriculum integration across physics & CS departments.

hubs.name: Quantum Brilliance
hubs.summary: Australian National University spinout building room-temperature diamond nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center quantum accelerators requiring no cryogenics or vacuum chambers.

stages.highschool: Discover how room-temperature diamond NV-center defects act as solid-state spins without liquid helium.
stages.undergrad: Summer internships in Canberra and Stuttgart in diamond nanophotonics, microwave control, and Qristal SDK.
stages.masters: MSc/MEng projects in precision ion implantation, optical confocal detection, and edge quantum-accelerator software.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Research Scientist tracks in NV-center spin coherence, diamond nanofabrication, and hybrid HPC.
stages.postdoc: Senior Quantum Physicist roles for solid-state spin, diamond NV-center, and quantum-sensing postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint ANU / Fraunhofer IAF / Pawsey Supercomputing Centre collaborations on room-temperature quantum clusters.
stages.prof: Australian ARC & German BMBF collaborative grants co-developing diamond fabrication and edge QPU ecosystems.

hubs.name: Helion Energy
hubs.summary: Developing pulsed magneto-inertial field-reversed configuration (FRC) fusion machines (Trenta & Polaris) designed for direct electromagnetic energy recovery using D–³He fuel.

stages.highschool: Learn pulsed magneto-inertial fusion and field-reversed configuration (FRC) physics via open plasma primers.
stages.undergrad: Paid summer internships in Everett, WA across pulsed power, plasma diagnostics, vacuum systems, and control software.
stages.masters: Graduate engineering roles in high-voltage capacitor banks, magnetic-compression coils, and fusion instrumentation.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Plasma Physicist roles in FRC formation/merging, kinetic/MHD modeling, and D–³He direct recovery.
stages.postdoc: Staff Plasma & Pulsed-Power Scientist roles transitioning from fusion, HEDP, or accelerator-physics postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Collaborative university plasma-diagnostics and MHD simulation projects supporting Polaris and commercial plants.
stages.prof: Scientific advisory partnerships and joint DOE INFUSE / university fusion workforce training initiatives.

hubs.name: TAE Technologies
hubs.summary: Pioneering beam-driven field-reversed configuration (FRC) plasmas (Norman & Copernicus) pursuing aneutronic hydrogen-boron (p–¹¹B) fusion alongside power-management and medical BNCT spinouts.

stages.highschool: Explore aneutronic hydrogen-boron (p–¹¹B) fusion physics and particle-beam plasma confinement concepts.
stages.undergrad: Summer internships in Foothill Ranch, CA in neutral-beam injectors, plasma diagnostics, and power electronics.
stages.masters: MSc/MEng roles in high-energy neutral beams, vacuum engineering, and machine-learning plasma optimization.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Physicist roles in beam-driven FRC stability, kinetic plasma theory, and p–¹¹B fusion diagnostics.
stages.postdoc: Senior Plasma Physicist positions for magnetic-fusion, neutral-beam, and computational-plasma postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: DOE INFUSE & university collaborations (UC Irvine, UW, national labs) on FRC physics and ML control.
stages.prof: Visiting collaborations, scientific advisory boards, and joint fusion-energy & accelerator-physics consortia.

hubs.name: Tokamak Energy
hubs.summary: Combines compact spherical tokamak geometry (ST40, which achieved 100-million-kelvin ion temperatures) with commercial high-temperature superconducting magnets.

stages.highschool: Explore spherical tokamak geometry and high-temperature superconductor (HTS) magnet demos via UK fusion outreach.
stages.undergrad: Paid UK industrial placements near Oxford in HTS coil testing, cryogenics, plasma diagnostics, and CAD/FEA.
stages.masters: MSc/MEng graduate schemes in REBCO magnet engineering, spherical-tokamak equilibrium modeling, and vacuum tech.
stages.phd: EPSRC iCASE / Fusion CDT PhD sponsorships in high-field spherical tokamak transport, RF heating, and HTS magnets.
stages.postdoc: Principal Plasma Physicist & HTS Magnet Scientist roles for tokamak and applied-superconductivity postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint UKAEA / Culham / Oxford & York university partnerships on ST40 experiments and DEMO magnet technology.
stages.prof: Co-supervision of Fusion CDT doctoral students and international public-private fusion pilot plant consortia.

hubs.name: First Light Fusion
hubs.summary: University of Oxford spinout developing projectile-driven inertial fusion amplifiers that focus hypervelocity shock waves onto fuel targets.

stages.highschool: Discover hypervelocity shock-wave physics and inertial-confinement target amplification principles.
stages.undergrad: UK summer placements in Oxfordshire in shock hydrodynamics, optical diagnostics, and two-stage light-gas guns.
stages.masters: MPhys/MSc thesis projects and graduate roles in multiphysics radiation-hydrodynamics simulation and target fab.
stages.phd: PhD research partnerships (Oxford, Imperial, York) in high-energy-density physics, equations of state, and shock focusing.
stages.postdoc: Staff HEDP & Computational Physicist roles for ICF, shock-physics, and radiation-hydrodynamics postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Collaborative university & Sandia Z-machine experimental campaigns validating amplifier target designs.
stages.prof: Co-PI research grants on inertial fusion energy (IFE) target physics and academic advisory boards.

hubs.name: Proxima Fusion
hubs.summary: First spinout from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (Wendelstein 7-X), designing quasi-isodynamic HTS stellarator fusion power plants via simulation-driven engineering.

stages.highschool: Learn how twisted 3D stellarator magnetic cages confine fusion plasma without disruptive plasma currents.
stages.undergrad: Munich summer internships in computational plasma optimization, HTS magnet engineering, and scientific Python/Julia.
stages.masters: Master's thesis placements (TUM / LMU / ETH) in quasi-isodynamic stellarator optimization and divertor physics.
stages.phd: Industrial PhD collaborations with Max Planck IPP on 3D MHD equilibria, neoclassical transport, and HTS coils.
stages.postdoc: Senior Stellarator Physicist & Magnet Engineer roles for magnetic-fusion and computational-physics postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint Max Planck IPP / EUROfusion / university grants designing next-generation HTS stellarator pilot plants.
stages.prof: Co-supervision of Munich/Greifswald fusion PhDs and European stellarator-reactor engineering consortia.

hubs.name: Marvel Fusion
hubs.summary: Pursuing short-pulse petawatt laser-driven fusion using nanostructured targets engineered to enhance laser absorption and non-thermal proton-boron fusion yield.

stages.highschool: Study chirped-pulse petawatt lasers and laser-plasma particle acceleration fundamentals.
stages.undergrad: Internships in Munich and Fort Collins (CSU) in ultrafast laser optics, nanofabricated targets, and PIC codes.
stages.masters: MSc thesis collaborations (LMU / TUM / Colorado State) in laser-solid interaction and nanostructured target physics.
stages.phd: Joint PhD projects in short-pulse laser-plasma physics, particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations, and proton-boron fusion.
stages.postdoc: Research Scientist roles for high-intensity laser, HEDP, and plasma-simulation postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Collaborative experimental campaigns at ELI, Colorado State ATLAS, and German petawatt laser facilities.
stages.prof: Co-PI leadership on public-private laser-fusion testbeds and joint university-industry doctoral fellowships.

hubs.name: Type One Energy
hubs.summary: Developing the Infinity Two HTS stellarator fusion pilot plant in partnership with TVA and Oak Ridge National Laboratory, leveraging high-field 3D optimized coils.

stages.highschool: Explore 3D stellarator coil geometry and high-temperature superconducting magnet fundamentals.
stages.undergrad: Summer engineering & physics internships in Knoxville, Madison, and Boston in magnet design and plasma modeling.
stages.masters: Graduate engineering roles in cryogenic coil winding, neutronics, and divertor thermal-hydraulics for Infinity Two.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Scientist roles in stellarator turbulence, gyrokinetic transport, and 3D HTS magnet mechanics.
stages.postdoc: Staff Fusion Physicist roles for stellarator-theory, gyrokinetics, and superconducting-magnet postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: DOE INFUSE & ORNL / UW–Madison partnerships advancing Infinity Two stellarator physics and materials.
stages.prof: Scientific advisory leadership and joint national-lab/TVA fusion pilot plant research consortia.

hubs.name: Zap Energy
hubs.summary: University of Washington spinout confining fusion plasma via sheared-flow-stabilized Z-pinches—eliminating expensive external superconducting magnets entirely.

stages.highschool: Learn how sheared plasma flows stabilize Z-pinches without external superconducting magnets.
stages.undergrad: Paid summer internships in Everett, WA in pulsed power, plasma spectroscopy, liquid-metal blankets, and diagnostics.
stages.masters: MSc/MEng roles in high-current electrode physics, neutron diagnostics, and thermal-hydraulic heat extraction.
stages.phd: PhD internships & Plasma Physicist roles in sheared-flow Z-pinch stability, MHD/kinetic simulations, and FuZE campaigns.
stages.postdoc: Senior Experimental & Computational Plasma Physicist roles for Z-pinch, HEDP, and fusion postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: DOE ARPA-E / INFUSE & University of Washington / LLNL collaborations on Z-pinch diagnostics and theory.
stages.prof: Joint fusion-energy pilot-plant working groups and co-supervised UW/national-lab doctoral research.

hubs.name: General Fusion
hubs.summary: Developing Magnetized Target Fusion (MTF) using synchronized mechanical pistons compressing a spinning liquid-lithium cavity around injected magnetized plasma (LM26).

stages.highschool: Explore Magnetized Target Fusion (MTF) and liquid-metal compression engineering concepts.
stages.undergrad: Canadian co-op placements in Richmond, BC in plasma injectors, pneumatic compression systems, and diagnostics.
stages.masters: MASc/MSc co-ops and graduate roles in magnetized plasma formation, liquid-lithium hydrodynamics, and controls.
stages.phd: Mitacs industrial PhD fellowships & Physicist tracks in spherical-tokamak MTF compression and LM26 plasma physics.
stages.postdoc: Staff Fusion Scientist roles for magnetic-confinement, pulsed-plasma, and MHD-simulation postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: NSERC / Mitacs / UKAEA academic collaborations on plasma-wall interactions and MTF compression modeling.
stages.prof: Collaborative fusion-engineering consortia and co-supervised Canadian/international plasma physics PhDs.

hubs.name: Focused Energy
hubs.summary: German-American TU Darmstadt spinout developing proton fast-ignition laser fusion, separating fuel compression from petawatt laser-accelerated proton ignition.

stages.highschool: Learn how petawatt lasers accelerate proton beams to ignite compressed inertial-fusion fuel.
stages.undergrad: Summer internships in Darmstadt and Austin, TX in high-power optics, cryogenic targets, and laser diagnostics.
stages.masters: MSc thesis placements (TU Darmstadt / UT Austin) in laser-driven proton acceleration and IFE chamber physics.
stages.phd: Joint PhD programs with TU Darmstadt, GSI, and US national labs on proton fast-ignition fusion physics.
stages.postdoc: Research Scientist positions for inertial-fusion, laser-plasma, and target-fabrication postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint DOE FIRE / German BMBF laser-fusion hub collaborations and shared beamtime at petawatt facilities.
stages.prof: Co-PI leadership in international inertial fusion energy (IFE) consortia and doctoral training networks.

hubs.name: ZEISS Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology (SMT)
hubs.summary: Crafts the world's smoothest multilayer Bragg reflective mirrors (surface flatness equivalent to sub-millimeter bumps over Germany) powering every ASML EUV lithography system.

stages.highschool: Explore precision optics, wave diffraction limits, and how EUV mirrors print nanometer transistors.
stages.undergrad: Dual-study programs & paid Praktika in Oberkochen in optical metrology, vacuum mechanics, and computational optics.
stages.masters: Paid Master's thesis placements (Masterarbeit) in Bragg multilayer coatings, interferometry, and optomechanics.
stages.phd: Industrial PhD tracks (Promotionsstellen) in EUV/High-NA lithography optics, X-ray reflectometry, and laser metrology.
stages.postdoc: Senior Optical Physicist & Systems Architect roles for optics, photonics, and precision-metrology postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint German BMBF / Fraunhofer IOF / university research chairs in extreme-UV optics and computational imaging.
stages.prof: Long-term collaborative research centers (SFB) and industrial advisory boards on next-generation lithography physics.

hubs.name: TRUMPF Laser Technology
hubs.summary: Builds the 30-kilowatt CO₂ drive lasers that vaporize 50,000 tin droplets per second inside EUV lithography machines alongside ultrafast industrial and scientific disk lasers.

stages.highschool: Discover high-power industrial lasers and how CO₂ laser pulses generate EUV plasma light from tin droplets.
stages.undergrad: Paid German Praxissemester & summer internships in Ditzingen in laser physics, optics, and power electronics.
stages.masters: Master's thesis placements (Masterarbeit) in ultrafast thin-disk lasers, EUV drive lasers, and beam delivery.

stages.undergrad: Paid summer internships in Boulder and Westminster, CO in optical metrology, cryogenics, and aerospace physics.
stages.masters: MSc/MEng engineering roles in space-telescope optics, focal-plane detectors, and cryogenic thermal control.
stages.phd: PhD Principal Physicist tracks in coronagraphic exoplanet optics (Roman/HWO), lidar, and cryogenic mirror testing.
stages.postdoc: Senior Space Optics & Instrumentation Scientist roles for experimental astrophysics and optics postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint NASA / university instrument teams co-developing Habitable Worlds Observatory and Earth-science payloads.
stages.prof: Flagship space-observatory prime-contractor partnerships (JWST, Roman, HWO) and national decadal-survey studies.

hubs.name: OHB SE
hubs.summary: European space prime contractor leading the ESA PLATO exoplanet telescope, Hera asteroid mission, Galileo atomic-clock navigation satellites, and LISA optical-bench subsystems.

stages.highschool: Explore European space physics missions including ESA PLATO exoplanet telescopes and LISA gravitational-wave optics.
stages.undergrad: Paid German Praktika & Werkstudent roles in Bremen and Oberpfaffenhofen in space optics and satellite systems.
stages.masters: Master's thesis placements (Masterarbeit) in optical-bench metrology, atomic-clock navigation (Galileo), and GNC.
stages.phd: Industrial PhD collaborations with DLR and German universities on LISA space-interferometry and planetary probes.
stages.postdoc: Space Systems & Optical Physicist roles for gravitational-wave, exoplanet-instrumentation, and aerospace postdocs.
stages.assoc_prof: Joint ESA / Horizon Europe / university instrument consortia for PLATO, Hera, Ariel, and LISA.
stages.prof: Prime-contractor scientific leadership on ESA Cosmic Vision and Voyage 2050 flagship physics missions.
